orchestration.substanceWhy: The core object is there: Run Detail has a graph of agents (Fetch Data → Validate → Transform → Store) with the agent ids as sub-lines, data-carrying edge labels ("rows: 2,847", "batches: 8") and a log card per agent. Around it are a runs list and an agent registry. It stops at 2 because the graph is a linear four-step chain with every node Done: no branching or parallel agents, no running or failed node, no state shown on the nodes. It reads as an ETL pipeline with agent names more than an agent orchestration run (no model, tokens, tool calls or handoffs). Also, the screen named "Workflows" actually holds the Agents list.

Header row justify=between: an l bold title and a primary button ("Recent Runs" / "New Run", "Agents" / "Add Agent")
Run rows built from primitives: a small circle shape as status dot, a two-line col (bold name + s mid meta), and a right-aligned status text
Graph dir=right with named node ids, sub= agent ids and labelled edges that carry data between steps
Agent log cards whose mono names (api_reader, schema_check, etl_agent, db_writer) match the graph subs and reappear in the Agents registry, so the data holds together across screens

recipes.substanceWhy: The three screens cover the core loop. Meals This Week groups recipe cards (image, name, time) under Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday. Recipe Detail has a hero image, servings/time, ingredients, method and an 'Add to Week' CTA. The Grocery List is grouped by aisle with checkboxes. Visible errors keep it from being convincing. The grocery screen puts guanciale, eggs and pecorino under 'Produce', and its '5 items' / '3 items' counts disagree with the 3 and 2 rows shown. The meal days carry weather temperatures instead of meal slots. The wrong tab is active.
composedWell: Day section = bold day + muted meta row, then a row of bordered recipe cards (shape w=fill h=80 image + bold name + xs time), a legible weekly plan

Recipe Detail: back-arrow / title / heart header row, 200px hero shape, servings-vs-time justify=between row, dividers between Ingredients (data-flagged lines) and a numbered Method, full-width primary 'Add to Week', which links recipe to plan
Grocery List grouped by bordered header rows (icon circle + bold category + item count) over rows of input check + item, using the check primitive correctly
Phone frame with status bar and a bottom tab bar (row h=60 justify=between border) reused on the list screens
